text: Change the planner's instructions and plan template. Before a plan goes to the critic, the planner must settle every open question and every 'producer to check' item that affects an acceptance criterion. For each production path the plan changes, it must list the existing callers and tests that run that path and say whether each still passes. Any test that would break must go into the deliverables, or the design must change. The plan must say where each new dependency comes from at each entry point. Show the critic any deviations the user has accepted, so it does not raise them again. Add a test that a plan template with an unresolved open question tied to a criterion is refused before review. This is separate from the queued item planning-cap-reached-job-fails-no-plan-kept, which is about keeping the last plan, not about what the plan must settle.
